description: This file defines the AppShell widget for a Flutter app, managing bottom navigation with nested navigators for different sections such as home, search, downloads, and profile.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a bottom navigation bar with independent navigation stacks for each tab.

classes.name: _AppShellState
classes.description: State class managing the navigation logic and UI for the AppShell widget.

methods.name: _AppShellState.createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for AppShell.

methods.name: _AppShellState._selectTab
methods.description: Handles tab selection, popping to root if the same tab is re-selected.

methods.name: _AppShellState._buildTabNavigator
methods.description: Constructs a nested Navigator widget for each tab with its own navigation stack.

methods.name: _AppShellState.build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including Scaffold, IndexedStack for switching views, and bottom NavigationBar.
